title: otites parviflorus
intro: Otites parviflorus, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as colds, fever, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Otites parviflorus include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
